about: Wall and roof colours and wall materials of single buildings as they are on site, where the map build's palettes would guess otherwise. Keyed by the building's identifier in the Hessian LoD2 models. Facts only - no pictures are kept here. Observed from street-level panoramas (2026-11). "add": buildings seen on the official aerial photographs (2026-11) that neither the LoD2 models nor OpenStreetMap have - outline in world metres (x east, z south), height to the eaves, roof flat|gable|hip; "remove": LoD2 models (or "w<OSM id>" footprints) that are not there. Per building also "roofShape": "flat" (the model's sloped roof cut flat, "flatAt" 0 = at the eaves … 1 = at the ridge) and "roofMaterial": green|flat|gravel|metal|tiles (green: a flat planted roof).
